A '''sturdy leather leggings''' is the [[Sturdy leather armor|sturdy leather]] [[Armor#Leggings|leggings]], crafted from [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]. It gives 3 armor and has 350 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sturdy_leather_pants.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/sturdy_leather/leggings</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 3 armor.

It adds 2 blocks of safe fall distance.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Projectile Protection]] III

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Sturdy leather armor]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Tattered Leather|tattered leather]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
